sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会に提出された議案
令和8年第1回定例会の会議結果

name: 学校医等の公務災害補償基礎額を改定
summary: 学校医、学校歯科医、学校薬剤師の公務災害補償には、職種などに応じた補償基礎額が定められています。この議案で金額を引き上げ、改定額は原則として令和7年4月1日以後に支給事由が生じた補償に適用します。それ以前に支給事由が生じた傷病・障害・遺族補償年金も、同日以後の期間分は対象です。
changes: 令和7年4月1日から令和8年3月31日まで、学校医・学校歯科医の勤続年数10年以上15年未満の補償基礎額を14,175円ではなく12,951円とする
who: 区立小中学校等の学校医・学校歯科医
区立小中学校等の学校薬剤師
why: 学校医等の補償基礎額を改定するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises base compensation amounts for school doctors and other school personnel
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Work-Related Accidents Involving School Doctors, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Taito City Municipal Elementary and Junior High Schools and Other Schools
en.summary: Compensation for work-related accidents involving school doctors, school dentists, and school pharmacists is based on amounts set according to factors such as occupation. This bill raises those amounts. In principle, the revised amounts apply to compensation for which the event giving rise to payment occurs on or after April 1, 2025. They also apply, for periods from that date onward, to injury-and-illness, disability, and survivors’ compensation pensions for which the event giving rise to payment occurred before that date.
changes: Raises the compensation base amounts for school doctors and school dentists as follows: ¥8,529 to ¥9,060; ¥9,909 to ¥10,332; ¥12,351 and ¥13,575 to ¥14,175; ¥15,837 to ¥16,467; and ¥16,866 to ¥17,496
Raises the compensation base amounts for school pharmacists as follows: ¥7,164 to ¥7,629; ¥7,932 to ¥8,340; ¥9,438 to ¥9,873; ¥10,701 to ¥11,073; ¥11,610 to ¥11,907; and ¥11,970 to ¥12,246

Sets the compensation base amount for school doctors and school dentists with 10 years or more but less than 15 years of service at ¥12,951 instead of ¥14,175 from April 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026
who: School doctors and school dentists at Taito City municipal elementary and junior high schools and other schools
School pharmacists at Taito City municipal elementary and junior high schools and other schools
en.why: The ward says this is to revise the compensation base amounts for school doctors and other school personnel.
